body: Pre-registered in research_notes/Backtests/lazy_prices_us_v2.md s0 before sampling or any return. Seed 2026112202; 2,235 candidate CIKs (float $300M-$10B, frames CY2022Q4I-CY2025Q1I), 1,797 processed -> 2,000 eligible firm-years (2024 1,085 / 2025H1 915); 3,215 primary docs, 0 failures. Pre-registered exclusions: 2 stubs (<50k chars), 27 first-10-Ks-after-de-SPAC (v1 regex) -> 1,971 analysed; 1,675 with usable Yahoo prices. Controls: same filing-year group, other quintiles, mcap x0.5-2 on event entry date, 5 nearest in log mcap with same 2-digit SIC (80% of H1 events) else 1-digit (19%). 12m decision horizon; bootstrap by filing month (15 clusters, two Februaries = 2/3 of events). H1 jac_full Q1: mean -1.39% [-10.56, +16.92], median -10.5%, winsorised -4.0%, hit 39.7%, t -0.25 -> NOT PROVEN (avoid benefit after 0.5% cost +0.9%). H2 jac_1a Q5: +0.49% [-14.0, +4.4], t +0.13 -> REJECTED/NO SIGN. Secondary: v1's own measures reversed or vanished - cos_full Q1 +5.3%, cos_1a Q5 (v1 stale RF -11.5%) now +10.7% (t +2.1), so v1's stale-RF result was most likely a biotech/sector-mix artifact. Size-only controls H1 -1.1%; ex-biotech H1 -1.3%, H2 +2.3%; by year H1 2024 +1.3%, 2025 -4.2%. cos_7 Q1 -9.5% (t -2.1, all 2025) is one of 20+ secondary cells = noise. Pattern (hypothesis only, seen in v1 and v2): changers have low median (-10 to -14%) and hit rate (38-40% vs ~50% for non-changers) but a fat right tail (ASTS ~+970%, BE/UUUU/COGT ~+480-540%) -> 'lottery ticket', not steady drift; a mean-based avoid rule would discard winners. Survivorship: changers 18.5% missing prices vs 11.7% for non-changers; bankruptcies 7 vs 2 (same direction as v1, tiny counts); bounds H1 -2.5% (bk at 0: -1.7%), H2 +6.6% - no verdict change. Conclusion: retire plain US Lazy Prices as a mechanical rule/filter; keep 'first 10-K after de-SPAC/transformation = look harder' and 'big text change = read the diff' as stage-4 judgment cues only. Next text-change test belongs in India (annual-report PDFs, v1 s7 pilot).
title: Lazy Prices US v2 (pre-registered, fresh 10-Ks filed 2024-01 to 2025-06, ex de-SPAC, 2-digit-SIC+size controls): H1 full-text Jaccard changers -1.4% at 12m (t -0.25, CI -10.6 to +16.9) = NOT PROVEN; H2 'stale risk factors' (Item 1A Jaccard top quintile) +0.5% (t +0.13) = REJECTED. v1's -7% effect and stale-RF finding do not replicate
